text: The Whispering Forest is haunted by forgotten spirits.
Elandor the Brave wielded a sword forged in dragonfire.
The ruins of Nareth hold the last secrets of the ancients.
Aralyn feels uneasy as the red moon rises.
The Silver Keep stands tall over the misty valley.
King Tharion rules with an iron will from his obsidian throne.
The Oracle of Lira speaks only in riddles and dreams.
Darkness seeps from the chasm near Black Hollow.
The enchanted glade glows under the light of the twin moons.
A pact was made in blood beneath the shattered altar.
